description: This file defines functions related to retrieving leaderboard data for various entities such as customers, items, suppliers, sales partners, and sales persons. It includes API endpoints for fetching aggregated data with filtering options based on date ranges and other criteria, primarily for reporting or dashboard purposes.

methods.name: get_leaderboards()
methods.description: Returns a dictionary defining various leaderboards for different entities such as Customer, Item, Supplier, Sales Partner, and Sales Person, including the fields to display, associated methods, and icons.

methods.name: get_all_customers(date_range, company, field, limit = None)
methods.description: Fetches a list of customers with either outstanding amounts or total sales, filtered by date range and company, with optional limit.

methods.name: get_all_items(date_range, company, field, limit = None)
methods.description: Retrieves item data, including stock and sales metrics, filtered by date range and company, with optional limit.

methods.name: get_all_suppliers(date_range, company, field, limit = None)
methods.description: Fetches supplier data with outstanding amounts or total purchase amounts, filtered by date range and company, with optional limit.

methods.name: get_all_sales_partner(date_range, company, field, limit = None)
methods.description: Retrieves sales partner data including total sales amount and commissions, filtered by date range and company, with optional limit.

methods.name: get_all_sales_person(date_range, company, field = None, limit = 0)
methods.description: Fetches sales persons' sales totals, filtered by date range, company, and limit.

methods.name: get_date_condition(date_range, field)
methods.description: Constructs SQL date filter condition based on provided date range and field.
